## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result of this pull request.

## Scope

- [ ] Web / PWA
- [ ] Android
- [ ] Command Center

## Verification

List the commands, devices, browsers, or workflows used to verify the change.

## Privacy and permissions

Describe any impact on network access, local storage, accounts, analytics, camera, microphone, files, location, or other device permissions. Write `None` when there is no impact.

## UI evidence

For visual changes, include before/after screenshots or a short recording with sensitive data removed.

## Checklist

- [ ] User-facing claims accurately describe the current implementation.
